title: [spec-gap][R-X509-033/034/035/036/038/039/040/043/053] Per-subject-key chain cache: freshness ordering + freshness floor
description: spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md section 6 and section 8 step 6: at most one cached chain per subject key; replace only if leaf notBefore strictly later AND cached chain within validity window; expired cached chain discarded and stops suppressing; future-dated cached entry MUST NOT suppress a currently-valid presented chain; out-of-window chain MUST NOT be honored nor displace a valid cached chain; MUST NOT honor a cached chain whose leaf expired; freshness floor (greatest leaf notBefore ever cached) gates displacement, floor SHOULD persist across restarts; expired body MAY be dropped once floor recorded, still-valid chain MUST NOT be dropped. Classification: not-implemented (no chain cache in any stack; nearest analogs: TOFU trust caches keyed by SIID rust/lichen-link/src/trust.rs; gateway trust-store MAC persistence rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs:90-95 could host the floor). Suggested placement: credential verifier cache in all three stacks (bedw epic consumers), floor persisted via existing trust-store persistence pattern.
